post.quote: Hold the standard high and the person higher.
post.practice: When someone misses the mark, separate the two out loud: 'The result isn't where it needs to be, and I believe you can get it there.'
post.question: Who needs to hear that you believe in them?

caption:
High standards and real care can live together.

“Hold the standard high and the person higher.”

Try this today: When someone misses the mark, separate the two out loud: 'The result isn't where it needs to be, and I believe you can get it there.'

Who needs to hear that you believe in them? Tell me in the comments.
